findings.text: follow-on: _NUMERIC_AGREEMENT recognises the spelling family agree/agrees/agreement but not the gerund agreeing, so a done-when that both declares an independent reading and phrases its agreement as 'agreeing to 0.5%' is refused although it names a tolerance; the unit alternation likewise admits only %/percent/seconds/ms/milliseconds, so 'agree within 0.5s' is refused. This is the over-refusal direction the census warns against (one false refusal teaches coordinators to stop running the check) and no test covers these spellings.

follow-on: _red_base_gate_finding runs the named pytest target under a 10-second timeout and turns a timeout (:1023) or an exited run with no readable FAILED lines (:1037) into a refusal, so a green named check that is merely slow, or that errors during collection without emitting FAILED ids, is refused, and dispatch validation now executes repository test code as a side effect.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 556e5b6f; f2f9d04 adds the three lints and the test file, and 7aaad17 adds twelve lines that put the validated checkout ahead of inherited import paths for the base pytest subprocess.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_done_when_lints.py's three cases plus the paired test_crew_node/test_crew_dryrun records; the manifest records baseline_suite with 3 failures (exactly the three new cases) and after_suite with 24 passed, and the declared negative control at EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is three dispatch done-when lints drawn from the section-15 census; reckon/crew/node.py:1232 and :1240 add the agreement and absence refusals inside validate_node, and node.py:969 _red_base_gate_finding adds the red-base refusal administered from gate_population_finding.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it carries the two commits, changed_paths, flat baseline_suite and after_suite JSON with log_paths, the negative_control_log path, and measurement_cwd of the base scratch arm at /tmp/done-when-base.IyFwYv.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/node.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_done_when_lints.py, an evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches only node.py and the test file, both inside the declared set.

justifications.durability: tests/test_done_when_lints.py:124 reddens when the agreement clause is removed (shown by the negative-control log at EXIT=1), and :168 proves both directions of the red-base path, but no test covers the agreement spellings _NUMERIC_AGREEMENT fails to recognise, so the guard's over-refusal is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: the paired gate the manifest records is the done_when's own gate and its log reconciles with the baseline_suite/after_suite fields (3 failing ids at base, 24 passed at head), with the negative control at tests/test_done_when_lints.py EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: the new patterns follow the module-level regex idiom of _EVIDENCE_SIGNALS and _GATE_POPULATION and the refusal uses the existing fail('demonstrable', ...) form, with no plan or ticket label introduced.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/node.py:1232 refuses an independent reading that carries only a plausibility band, :1240 refuses measured-or-unmeasured evidence without a positive coverage floor and base count, and :969 reads a named base check for an absolute-green demand, matching all three clauses of the goal.
justifications.scope_discipline: the whole diff is reckon/crew/node.py and tests/test_done_when_lints.py, both inside the declared write paths, and carries nothing the goal does not imply.
